steps: CAMPAIGN CREATION: In admin_app/lib/features/actions/screens/campaign_control_screen.dart, add a FloatingActionButton that shows a dialog to create a new campaign. The dialog should have fields: title, description, budget (number), platform (dropdown: Instagram/YouTube/Twitter), status defaults to 'active'. On submit, insert into 'campaigns' table via SupabaseService.client.from('campaigns').insert({...}) and invalidate adminCampaignsProvider. Follow the same pattern as ShopAdminScreen's _showCreateProductDialog.

ADMIN PROFILE SCREEN: Create admin_app/lib/features/settings/screens/admin_profile_screen.dart. Show admin name and email from SupabaseService.currentUser (email) and getUserProfile. Show admin role badge. Add logout button that calls ref.read(authProvider.notifier).signOut() and navigates to /login. Include an avatar section showing first letter of name. Follow the styling patterns in the admin app (PremiumCard, AppColors, etc.).

ADD PROFILE TO BOTTOM NAV: In admin_app/lib/core/widgets/app_bottom_nav.dart, add a 5th nav item 'Profile' with Iconsax.profile_circle icon. Update the router in admin_app/lib/core/router/app_router.dart to add a 5th StatefulShellBranch for /profile that shows AdminProfileScreen.

VERIFY DEPOSITS/WITHDRAWALS: The admin deposit_queue_screen.dart and withdrawal_queue_screen.dart already query 'deposits' and 'withdrawals' tables with .eq('status', 'pending'). They have approve/reject buttons. The admin_provider.dart has approveDeposit, rejectDeposit, approveWithdrawal, rejectWithdrawal methods. This is working as designed - no changes needed. Just verify the screens render correctly.
